# Ara Partners

> > Ara Partners is a private equity firm specializing in industrial decarbonization investments across North America and Europe, with a focus on mid-market infrastructure and sustainability solutions.

Founded by Troy Thacker and team, Ara Partners operates from Houston, Dublin, and Boston, managing both private equity and infrastructure funds. The firm invests in portfolio companies like Blue Whale Materials, Fluitron, Divert, and Cycle∅, targeting sectors including battery recycling, hydrogen infrastructure, renewable energy, and waste-to-value solutions.

## Key Topics

- Industrial decarbonization
- Private equity investing
- Infrastructure Fund I
- Battery recycling and circular economy
- Hydrogen infrastructure
- Renewable energy and biomethane
- Portfolio company operations
- Sustainability partnerships
- Mid-market investments
- Clean technology
- Waste-to-value solutions
- Team expansion and talent
- Safety culture
- Dublin and Houston operations
